_comment: 36 mission cards built from the 17 effect types printed in the official ATM Gaming rulebook (pp. 14-19). The rulebook illustrates each EFFECT but does not list the per-card parameters (how many cards each mission deals, which X values, arrow directions, which cursed numbers). Those parameters below are a reasonable reconstruction - edit them if you have the physical cards, then rerun generate.py.
_fields: title = short name for the card; text = effect wording; cards = numbered cards dealt to each player (printed bottom-left on the real cards); expert = true for the red-flagged Expert missions.
